page.gettingToTitle: Find your way to La Roca Village

childMarkdownRemark.html: Just 40 minutes from Barcelona, yet a world apart.
From Estació del Nord in Barcelona direct to the Village.
Travel from Barcelona Sants in just 30 minutes.
Free parking and electric car charging points.
We’re always on hand to make sure you have an effortless shopping experience.

Shop tax free and save up to 21% more on your favourite brands. Guests from the UK (excluding NI) can now also take advantage of tax-free shopping, saving even more at our Village. It's easy. Just follow these simple steps.
Our expert stylists know the boutiques inside out.
Enjoy a spot right by the boutiques. Book now by sending an email to: Conciergeservices@LaRocaVillage.com or by calling or sending a WhatsApp message to: +34 628 125 891.
We'll carry your bags, so you don't have to. Book now by sending an email to: Conciergeservices@LaRocaVillage.com or by calling or sending a WhatsApp message to: +34 628 125 891.

faqPeekList.heading: How do I get a Gift Card?
Are pets allowed in the Village?

childMarkdownRemark.html: Pets are allowed in the Village. Please note, each boutique operates its own policy for allowing pets.

faqPeekList.heading: Do I have to pay for parking?

childMarkdownRemark.html: No, we offer complimentary parking to all Village guests.

faqPeekList.heading: How do I download the Village app?

childMarkdownRemark.html: Download the free Village app, available for iOS and Android, from the App Store here or from Google Play here.
